notes.title: Exciting News about the game!
notes.content:
I got exciting news (atleast for me): The store page for the FULL GAME is now live!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3277640/BugSplash_TD__Debugged/

Whats the difference to the free version?

[b]The full game is scheduled to include:[/b]
- a tutorial
- 24 different towers
- more maps
- challenges (which will probably translate to Steam Achievements later on)
- idle maps to farm for upgrades

and of course support for future user ideas & feature requests

Thats it for today
Have a nice week!

notes.title: Patchnotes V0.3.1f & V0.3.1g
notes.content:
Patchnotes:
- Added a soundtrack to the game
- Added the option to disable the soundtrack
- Added Credit Page
- Added some minor menu QoL features
- Restructured some menus
- Leaving a map now needs to be confirmed to prevent leaving by accident
- Made minor changes to most maps (everything should now be more smooth and a bit easier)
- Added a new map

Thats it for today!
